edits.find: skipped=$(grep -oE "⚠ [0-9]+ site\(s\) skipped \(could not prepare\):.*" "${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/audit.out" | tail -n1 | sed -e 's/%/%25/g' -e 's/\r/%0D/g'
edits.replace: skipped=$(grep -oE "⚠ [0-9]+ site\(s\) skipped \(could not prepare\):.*" "${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/audit.out" | tail -n1

edits.find:
# The gate's warnings print before the no-verdict exit too, so a crash that left a
          # summary but no verdict still names the sites it could not write (#1942 item 5).
          grep -E "^FLEET_WRITE_GATE_WARNING " "${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/audit.out" | sed 's/^FLEET_WRITE_GATE_WARNING /::warning::fleet Lighthouse: /' || true
          gate=$(grep -E "^FLEET_WRITE_GATE verdict=(red|green)$" "${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/audit.out" | tail -n1 || true)
          if [ -z "$gate" ]; then
            echo "::error::fleet Lighthouse printed no FLEET_WRITE_GATE verdict — cannot confirm what was measured."
            exit 1
          fi
